title: poqa-findings v1
description: Common result format of the poqa suite (poqa-analytics, poqa-security, poqa-live, web-checks). Contract described in docs/poqa-findings.md. Adding optional fields keeps v1; removing a field or changing its meaning is v2.

tool.description: The program that wrote this document.

generated_at.description: When the checks ran (not when the document was exported), RFC 3339 in UTC.

kind.description: code: a source tree (analytics, security, web-checks source/build mode); environment: a deployed environment seen from outside (poqa-live); web: pages in a browser (web-checks live mode); host: a machine seen from inside (reserved).

targets.description: Project path, URL(s) or host name(s), in the order the run received them.

env.description: Environment name, when the run targets one (poqa-live --env).

git.description: Revision of the checked source tree, when it is a git checkout.

complete.description: False when an engine failed or a target could not be checked, so some results are missing: an empty result list is not a clean run unless complete is true.

engines.description: Outcome of every engine (external tool or delegated program) the run used or skipped. Empty when everything ran in-process.

by_severity.description: Results with status warn or fail, by severity. Results without a severity are not counted here.

gate.description: Present only when the run applied an opt-in CI gate.

threshold.description: The gate as given, e.g. "--fail-on-status fail" or "--fail-below-grade C".

properties.description: Tool-specific extra data about the whole run (e.g. the web-checks grade). Consumers must not depend on it to interpret the results.

check.description: Id of the rule or check that produced the result (RUN-01, api.health, LongMethod, a scanner rule id). Many results can share it.

fingerprint.description: Identity of this result across runs, unique within the document: two runs that produce the same fingerprint are reporting the same thing (used by diffs).

status.description: pass: holds. warn: a problem that does not block. fail: a problem; the subject is not as expected. error: could not be verified (timeout, unreachable, engine failure). skipped: not run, see skip_reason.

severity.description: How bad the problem is, independently of the status.

category.description: Grouping inside the tool: suite, pack, scanner family (secrets, dependency, sast, iac), lint, smell, duplication.

engine.description: Engine that produced the result when it is not the tool itself (opengrep, betterleaks, biome).

path.description: Path relative to the project root.

symbol.description: Function, class or package the result is about.

properties.description: Tool-specific extra data. Consumers must not depend on it to interpret the result.
